name: Confirmation Party Details 9
definition: Parties used for acting parties that apply either to the whole message or to individual sides.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for an organisation that is allocated by an institution, eg, Dun & Bradstreet Identification.

ProcessingIdentification.name: Processing Identification
ProcessingIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction for the party identified.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Provides additional information to a party identification.

InvestorProtectionAssociationMembership.name: Investor Protection Association Membership
InvestorProtectionAssociationMembership.definition: Indicates whether the confirmation party is a member of the investor protection association required, eg, as per regulation.
